_comment_for_humans: Single source of truth for Selva's tier pricing. Edits must trace back to the Tulana decision doc cited in `generated_from`. The CI drift check (tests/test_pricing_codification.py + a grep gate) prevents these numbers from being hardcoded anywhere else in the repo. To change a number: (1) update the Tulana decision doc with rationale, (2) update this JSON, (3) bump `last_updated`, (4) verify confidence level, (5) merge in one PR so the trail is intact.

tulana_metered_hourly_packs._doc: Per the Tulana decision doc (2026-04-25). Confidence: medium — only Selva product with a Tulana v0.1 SKU. Numbers are MXN/hr metered against agent-hours consumed. v0.2 will replace these with WTP-validated values.

dhanam_subscription_daily_limits._doc: Per-tier daily compute-token budget. These were the hardcoded fallback in apps/nexus-api/nexus_api/billing_tiers.py before this codification. Same numbers, now JSON-sourced. Stripe webhook handlers (apps/nexus-api/nexus_api/routers/stripe_webhooks.py) override at runtime via the autoswarm:tier:<org_id> Redis key when a customer.subscription.* event lands. This dict is the cache-miss fallback only.

external_a2a_default._doc: Default daily quota for external A2A callers when their per-caller subscription_tier is unset. RFC 0018 (in flight) introduces per-caller tenant rows that override this. Until that lands, every external A2A caller shares the synthetic 'a2a-external' org with this hard cap.
